_about: Editor-only data for Assets/Editor/JoanSwap.cs (Hades > Joan menu): which roster id is cloned (templateId) into which new object (newId), where the source glb comes from, which glb nodes stay hidden, and how glb materials map to Mats/*.mat built from Tex/<tex>_base.jpg + _normal.jpg (Tools/char_tex_install.py writes the jpgs from hdrp_char_mats.json 'extract'). glbMaterial names are the CHEF names (Ch13_body, Ch13_hair, Heraldry, Steel, Leather): check them against joan_chef_v1.glb (python _agents/laneJOAN/tools/glb_measure.py <glb> prints 'materials') and edit here and in hdrp_char_mats.json extract[].groups[].glbMaterial together. glbHeightM = rest-pose skinned height of the chef body (tools/skinned_measure.py), used only if BakeMesh cannot measure.
